caption: Medici tower village, Santo Stefano di Sessanio
composition: Dark highland stone houses and cylindrical Medici tower in the Gran Sasso · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera faces the ruined stone village of Santo Stefano di Sessanio under the high 14:48 afternoon sun. The tall cylindrical Medici tower rises at center-right above the jumble of roofless grey houses cascading down the slope, their dark stone walls glowing in the light. The great blue ridges of the Gran Sasso massif march along the horizon behind, and the clear sky emphasizes the stark, windswept beauty of the abandoned highland village.
